Considering the aforesaid fact, the petitioner is directed to file a joint affidavit before the learned court below that the petitioner and the O.P. No.-2 are willing to live together and if such affidavit is filed within a period of four weeks from today, the petitioner would be released on provisional pre-arrest bail for a period of one year on such terms and conditions as fixed by the learned court below and after observing the conduct of the petitioner and no any complaint is filed by O.P. No.-2 against the petitioner, the provisional pre-arrest bail granted to Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.62411 of 2022(2) dt.16-05-2023 the petitioner would be confirmed, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
